item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)

expect.asks_about: Which of the two attached pictures should be upscaled?

item.title: Resolve the Upscale Target
item.tests: Asks which attachment the user means, then upscales only the selected picture without guessing or processing both.

answer_sheet.Framing: Keep the whole lake picture and its original proportions.

must_haves: The final deliverable is an upscaled version of lake-small.jpg, following clarification.
The lake, mountains, trees, clouds, and their arrangement remain faithful to the selected source.
The delivered image has larger pixel dimensions than lake-small.jpg, not merely a renamed copy.
The full original framing and aspect ratio are preserved.
Only one edited image is delivered; the dog photo is not included or blended into it.

turns.text: can you make this pic or this pic clearer
turns.agent:
I couldn't make either photo clearer. Magic Hour turned the request down because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was made and no credits were used.

I tried the lake photo first because it's the one that would improve most. I asked for the cheapest option: double the size, keeping the image as it is. The cost is roughly 25 credits or more, depending on the setting.

- **Lake:** This photo is just small and a bit soft. Doubling its size would make the trees, mountains and reflections noticeably sharper.
- **Dog:** This one is very blurry. Upscaling it would make it bigger but not much sharper, because the detail isn't there to recover. The other option is an AI edit that redraws a sharp version. It would look clear, but the fur and face would be made up and might not look exactly like your dog.

To go ahead, you'll need more credits, either by buying a credit pack or upgrading your plan. Then tell me which photo you want, or both, and for the dog whether a redrawn version is OK. I'll run it and send you the download links.
